title: Xianxia Aerial Duel: Talisman Master vs Sword Immortal (25s Chained Storyboard) / 古典仙俠・崇山空戰：符修與劍修巔峰對決 (25秒連貫分鏡)
description: 5-segment continuous cinematic Xianxia aerial pursuit and duel over mist-shrouded karst peaks, featuring dramatic cause-and-effect character tension, synchronized kinetic momentum, embedded Chinese dialogue tags, and anti-drift character anchor reset.

segments.title: Part 1 (0-5s): Supersonic Cloud-Sea Pursuit / 裂空急墜・雲海截殺
segments.prompt: [Scene] Boundless sea of tumbling golden sunset clouds rolling between colossal vertical karst mountain pillars. [Camera] High-speed forward tracking shot diving parallel to the slipstream, chasing the two flying figures. segments.title: Part 4 (15-20s): Canyon Dive & Mid-Air Blade Clash / 絕壁俯衝・近身激撞
